# Pengye Leather — Premium Leather Materials Supplier from China

> Huizhou Pengye Trading Co., Ltd. — 20 years one-stop leather sourcing for global buyers. We export only; we do not buy materials.

## Who we are
- Manufacturer-direct supplier of shoe-material leathers from Guangdong, China
- 20 years in the leather trade, family-run, factory-direct pricing
- Flexible low MOQ, real-time quotes, pre-shipment inspection
- Physical showroom open to visitors in Huidong County, Huizhou (Aoding Plot, Shaliyuan Industrial Zone, Daling Town, 516321)
- Online retail on Amazon (hydrolysis-resistant PU leather only)

## Products
- Genuine leather (full grain / split / reconstituted) — priced per chi (尺), hides sold per piece, ~13–14 chi per hide
- Water-based PU leather — priced per ma (码); 1 ma = 0.9 m × 1.37 m
- Eco-friendly PU leather
- Standard PU / PVC leather
- Bio-based PU leather
- Microfiber leather
- Specialty / functional leather (high elasticity, hydrolysis resistant, scratch resistant)
- Recycled PET leather

All are shoe-material leathers. For sofa / auto / furniture leather we help source on request (tell us first).

## Ordering & shipping
- Order online: submit specs, we reply with real-time material + freight quote within 24h
- Genuine leather priced per chi (尺); other leathers priced per ma (码)
- Freight charged at real-time carrier rates, confirmed before payment
- Customer-nominated carriers supported (choose your own forwarder)
- Sample policy: genuine leather & microfiber samples are charged; other materials advised on inquiry — contact us first

## Testing
- Domestic (CN) standard by default
- International tests (REACH, FDA, OEKO-TEX, EN71-3, etc.) on request — tell us your target country in advance
